title: RUJI Liquidations
liquidationCollateralHeaderTooltip: The asset posted to secure the loan. When the position is liquidated, this is the asset bidders can receive.
liquidationDebtHeaderTooltip: The asset owed by the borrower. Liquidation bids repay this debt in exchange for the collateral.
liquidationDirectionHeaderAria: Shows how the liquidation maps to the underlying trading pair. Buy means buying the base asset at a discount with the quote asset. Sell means selling the base asset at a premium for the quote asset, which is equivalent to buying the quote asset at a discount with the base asset.
liquidationDirectionHeaderTooltip:
Shows how the liquidation maps to the underlying trading pair.
  • Buy means buying the base asset at a discount with the quote asset.
  • Sell means selling the base asset at a premium for the quote asset
liquidationDirectionSellTooltip: Sell {{base}} at a premium for {{quote}}. Equivalent to buying {{quote}} at a discount with {{base}}.
liquidationLtvHeaderTooltip: Loan-to-value compares the debt to the adjusted collateral value. A higher LTV means the position is closer to liquidation. At 100% or higher, the position can be liquidated.
description: Buy crypto assets below market price through transparent liquidation auctions with open participation for everyone on Rujira.
liquidationBidDiscountTooltip: Discount shows how far your bid is placed from the market price in your favor. A higher discount can give you a better deal on the liquidated collateral, but your bid may take longer to fill, if it fills at all.
liquidationBidEstimatedExecutionPrice: Bid price based on current price
liquidationBidEstimatedExecutionPriceToo: Estimate based on current price. Your actual execution price depends on the market price when your order is filled.

liquidationBidHelpTooltip:
A bid lets you place an order for future liquidations, giving you a chance to receive liquidated collateral at a better price than the current market.

Instead of setting a fixed price, you choose a discount, which determines how far from the market price your bid is placed in your favor when a liquidation occurs. The market price is measured by THORChain's enshrined oracle at the time the liquidation occurs.

Liquidations are executed as market orders on the RUJI Trade orderbook. Bids closer to the market price are more likely to fill first. Larger discounts can give you a better deal on the liquidated collateral, but they are harder to fill because the market needs to move further before your bid can be matched.

You can view and manage your open bids at any time in Open Orders on RUJI Trade or in the Orders section of your Portfolio, where they appear as Tracking Orders.

Example: If the market price is $100 and you set a {{defaultDiscount}}% discount, your bid targets execution {{defaultDiscount}}% better than the market price. If a liquidation occurs and enough collateral is available at your bid level, your order can be matched automatically.
